title.en: Frontier-AI Employees Call for Verifiable Technical and Governance Tools to Pace Development
title.zhHans: 前沿 AI 员工发表联合声明，呼吁建立调节 AI 发展速度的技术与治理机制

searchSummary.en: A cross-company employee statement asks the US government to support international technical and governance tools that could deliberately pace frontier AI development if future risks require it.
searchSummary.zhHans: 一份跨公司的员工声明呼吁美国政府支持国际技术和治理工具，以便在未来风险需要时有能力调节前沿 AI 的发展速度。

summary.en: On July 28, 2026, employees from frontier AI companies published Pacing the Frontier, a statement asking the US government to support an international effort to build tools for deliberately pacing automated AI development. The statement represents a coordination signal, not a current pause or binding company policy.
summary.zhHans: 2026 年 7 月 28 日，来自前沿 AI 公司的员工发布《调节前沿发展》声明，呼吁美国政府支持国际努力，建立能够在必要时调节自动化 AI 发展的工具。这是协调意愿的信号，不是当前暂停开发，也不是具有约束力的公司政策。

narrative.en: Frontier AI employees face a coordination dilemma: labs may desire the option to deliberately pace automated AI development if risks surge, but cannot easily pause unilaterally in competitive markets. The statement asks the US government to support international efforts to build verifiable technical and governance mechanisms. The signatory count surpassed 1,300 across major labs, but the declaration carries no legal mandate or timetable and was signed in individual capacities.
narrative.zhHans: 前沿 AI 员工面临协调困境：如果能力进展超过安全与治理能力，各实验室可能希望保留放慢发展的选项，但在竞争压力下难以单方面暂停。声明呼吁美国政府支持建立可验证的技术与治理机制。签署人数在主要实验室中已超 1,300 人，但声明不具法律约束力或具体时间表，且签署者均以个人身份参与。

description.en: The statement makes cross-company coordination around optional future pacing mechanisms a visible governance issue rather than a private safety discussion.
description.zhHans: 这份声明使跨公司协调未来调节机制成为公开的治理议题，而不再只是实验室内部的安全讨论。

text.en: Pacing the Frontier was published on July 28, 2026 and asks the US government to support an international effort to develop tools for deliberately pacing frontier automated AI development.
text.zhHans: 《调节前沿发展》于 2026 年 7 月 28 日发布，呼吁美国政府支持国际努力，建立能够调节前沿自动化 AI 发展的工具。

text.en: The statement is an observable cross-lab coordination signal, but it does not establish a current pause, an international agreement or a binding company policy.
text.zhHans: 这份声明是可观察到的跨实验室协调信号，但没有建立当前暂停、国际协议或具有约束力的公司政策。

text.en: The unusual breadth of signatories suggests that some frontier-lab employees see unilateral restraint as unstable under competitive pressure.
text.zhHans: 签署者的跨公司范围表明，一些前沿实验室员工认为，在竞争压力下单方面克制并不稳定。

text.en: Signatories comment in a personal capacity, and the statement does not define the trigger, scope, verification method or enforcement mechanism of a future pacing arrangement.
text.zhHans: 签署者以个人身份发表评论，声明没有定义未来调节安排的触发条件、范围、验证方法或执行机制。
